Aquazone - Desktop Life.name: Aquazone Desktop Life
Aquazone - Desktop Life.summary: Aquazone Desktop Life (アクアゾーン) is a fish tank simulator developed and published by 9003 as part of their Aquazone series of "games".

Falcom Classics.name: Falcom Classics
Falcom Classics.summary: Falcom Classics (ファルコムクラシックス) is a compilation of three classic games by Falcom for the Sega Saturn. Each game has been enhanced to take advantage of the superior specifications of the Saturn console, though their non-enhanced counterparts can also be played.

Shinrei Jusatsushi Taroumaru.name: Shinrei Jusatsushi Taroumaru
Shinrei Jusatsushi Taroumaru.summary: Shinrei Jusatsushi Taroumaru is an Action game, developed and published by Time Warner Interactive, which was released in Japan in 1997.
